name: Interactive station strip
definition: Horizontal journey of selectable stations, navigable with arrow keys, with a detail panel below and a legend of milestones.
bestUse: Walking through a journey step by step during the talk.

demo.how: Stations sit on one horizontal line, with diamonds for milestones and dots for ordinary steps. Click a station or use the arrow keys, Home and End to move along it; the panel below shows what happens there and how many users reach it. Reset returns to the start. Data is illustrative.
